nodes.description:
Proposed test design for Skills in the Selection section of https://qapracticehub.com/. Review before approval.
## Preconditions
- Open QA Practice Hub and navigate to Selection.
- All Skills checkboxes are initially unchecked.

## Test steps
1. Select Selenium.
   Expected: Only Selenium is checked; Playwright, Cypress and Appium are unchecked.
2. Select Playwright.
   Expected: Selenium and Playwright are checked; Cypress and Appium are unchecked.
3. Deselect Selenium.
   Expected: Only Playwright remains checked.
4. Deselect Playwright.
   Expected: All Skills checkboxes are unchecked and the Skills summary displays None selected.

## Acceptance criteria
- Changing one skill does not change another skill selected state.
- Selected states and the Skills summary match the actions.

Test design only. Execution and automation completion are not claimed.
